action.intent: Inspect population, provisions, and the current date before establishing food production and shelter.
Return to the map and inspect the surface terrain near the wagon before choosing an entrance.
Inspect beneath the snowy ice surface to locate suitable ground for a secure underground fortress.
Inspect ground near the wagon to choose a safe entrance away from ice.
Designate an entrance stair beside the wagon and inspect the ground beneath it.
Return to the intended entrance tile and inspect the surface before designating stairs.
Inspect the layer beneath the grass beside the wagon before digging an entrance.
Return to the surface and select downward stairs for the entrance near the wagon.
Designate the entrance stairs and connecting stairs below, then let miners work.
Excavate an initial underground workroom beside the completed stair.
Inspect the excavated floor to determine whether it supports underground farming.
Place an underground farm on the confirmed silty clay floor.
Size a 3×3 underground farm on excavated soil.
Place the valid 3×3 underground farm plot and allow construction and excavation to proceed.
Inspect the farm plot to configure crops.
Set the farm to grow plump helmets in every season.
Select plump helmets with the crop-list navigation key and apply to every season.
Confirm plump helmets for every season and inspect the summer crop setting.
Place a carpenter's workshop in the excavated room.
Return to the surface and open tree-chopping designation to obtain workshop materials.
Exit building placement and open tree-cutting designations.
Designate nearby trees for chopping and let the dwarves work.
Open carpenter workshop placement now that felled logs are visible.
Place the carpenter's workshop at the valid surface location and inspect material selection.
Select a log to construct the carpenter's workshop.
Let dwarves construct the carpenter's workshop and continue mining and farming.
Inspect the carpenter's workshop before queuing furniture and barrels.
Open the completed carpenter's workshop job menu.
Queue seven beds and three barrels at the carpenter.
Let dwarves construct the seven queued beds and three barrels while mining and farming proceed.
Inspect the underground level and open still placement to establish brewing.
Position the still on excavated underground floor and inspect material choices.
Select an apple wood log to construct the still, then allow the dwarves to work.
Exit the build menu and let dwarves construct the still and finish carpentry.
Inspect the still's construction and available brewing jobs.
Find a dwarf to enable brewing labor so the still can be constructed.
Inspect the idle jeweler's labor settings to assign brewing.
Return from Lokum's profile to the unit list to access labor controls.
Zoom to Lokum and open native labor preferences to enable brewing.
Open Lokum's farming labors to enable brewing.
Disable accidental mining assignment and open Lokum's farming labors using menu scrolling.
Enable brewing and plant gathering for Lokum.
Return to the underground level and prepare a food stockpile.
Designate an underground food stockpile beside the farm and still.
Resume to allow workshop construction, bed production, farming and food hauling.
Inspect the still to begin drink production.
Select the still and inspect available brewing jobs.
Try to queue plant brewing and let the carpenter finish beds and barrels.
Leave the still menu and let dwarves complete beds, barrels, and farm work.
Check whether barrels are available to start brewing.
Let carpentry progress, then inspect the carpenter's workshop.
Start placing beds in the excavated shelter.
Place the first bed in the excavated shelter.
Place the first available bed underground and allow construction to proceed.
Inspect the installed bed and define sleeping quarters.
Expand the bedroom area and mark it as a communal dormitory.
Place a second bed in the confirmed dormitory.
Confirm the second bed and begin placing the third beside it.
Place the remaining five beds and let dwarves install them.
Inspect the still and establish reliable brewing.
Open the still’s job menu to set up brewing.
Check the carpenter's workshop for barrel production because brewing is unavailable.
Keep barrel production running and give dwarves time to work.
Check current food and drink reserves and fortress status.
